approval_asked.description: The pending request to post it, while it is submitted.

checks.description: getExpenseClaim only: what stops a draft being submitted (✖), and the warnings it posts with (⚠), such as a line above its category's limit, which finance approves too.

claimant.description: Who claims: the member the company owes.

input_tax_decisions.description: getExpenseClaim only: how each line's input tax was decided, one a line in order (FR-AP-20).

ledger_impact.description: getExpenseClaim only: the lines posting it writes (a draft), or wrote (posted): debits positive.

examples: Client lunch ran over the meals limit.

number.description: Its number from the claim sequence, given when it is first saved (FR-ORG-04).

posted_by.description: Who approved it last: its entry's poster.

returned.description: Its latest return, while it is returned.

stage.description: Where it stands for its claimant (FR-AP-14): draft; submitted while its approval waits; returned when its latest request was rejected, with the comment; approved once posted; paid once reimbursements paid back all it owes. scheduled arrives with payment batches.

status.description: Draft (✎) until it is approved, then posted.

total.description: What the company owes for it in the base currency, as posted or as posting would post it; absent while it cannot post.

version.description: The version of its content; with the status it makes the ETag.
